request.user:
Subject: Botany
Question type: single-correct (exactly one option is right)

(NEET 2019) Which of the following is the green expanded part ofleaf with vein and veinlets?
(A) Petiole
(B) Node
(C) Stipule
(D) Lamina

result.working:
A leaf has three parts: the leaf base (which may bear stipules), the petiole and the lamina.
The lamina, or leaf blade, is the green expanded part. It has a midrib, veins and veinlets.
The petiole is the stalk that holds the blade. Stipules are small lateral outgrowths at the leaf base.
A node is the point on the stem where a leaf arises, so it is not part of the leaf at all.
The answer is therefore Lamina.
result.note: The question text has a typo: 'ofleaf' should read 'of leaf'.
